==Skin Trivia==
*The first and second version of the Default skin resembled YouTuber [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCojsj6T5tNPGPZSx7wn4coQ JOHN ROBLOX].
*The first version of the '''Militant''' (known as '''John''' at the time) at level 3-5 used the [[w:c:left4dead:M60 Machine Gun|M60 Machine Gun]] model from ''Left 4 Dead: 2''.
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Ace Pilot}} skin is a reference to JOHN ROBLOX's obsession with [[w:c:darling-in-the-franxx:Zero Two|Zero Two]].
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Ace Pilot}} skin did not play any audio when the ''Gorilla Sounds'' ability was used.
**During [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], however, it used a line from the anime ''Macross Delta'', "kakugo surun yo", or in English, "Ya better be prepared!"
***This is a reference to JOHN ROBLOX's video, [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y_NfKixI3Sk zerotwo but in roblox].
*When the '''Militant's''' (known as '''John''' at the time) appearance was updated on the 4th of March 2020, the upgrade icons did not change.
**Most notably, the store icon of '''John''' still showed it wielding an M4A1.
**Additionally, the ''Laser Sight'' and ''Improved Handling'' icons were swapped.
*None of the lasers for the Desert Eagle were attached to the laser sight when the design of all the skins changed on the 4th of March 2020.
*When released, the Level 5 {{Color|Premium|Hazmat}} skin had a glitch, causing it to not fire. It would be automatically deleted after a few seconds.
**Until the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], its idle animation was broken, causing a deformity to be seen.
*Originally, the first version of Level 2 {{Color|Halloween2019|Pumpkin}} had a glitched yellow laser. It wouldn't be attached to the weapon but instead it would be sunk into the ground far below the actual tower.
**The first version of it was also originally supposed to wield a Winchester rifle instead of an FN FAL, this however was never added.
***The Winchester rifle would later be re-used for the old {{Color|Premium|Redemption}} and {{Color|Golden}} [[Cowboy]] skins.
*The '''Militant''' has an unreleased ''Delinquent'' skin, originally meant to be released with the Arsenal x Tower Defense Simulator crossover event, which has never come into fruition.
*The {{Color|Lovely|Chocolatier}} skin was based on a Valentines skin submission, the [https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/615753550626291717/679211636661157898 Chocolate Maker] skin for the '''Militant'''.
